name: Share
description: Use the system's share functionality to share something via another app.

conditions.description: Test if the sharing actions are supported on this platform.
Test if sharing files via the 'Add file' action is supported on this platform.
Triggered after the user completes a share. Note this does not necessarily mean anything was shared.
Triggered if a share is not completed successfully or an error occurs.

actions.description: Share some text with an optional title and URL, and any files that were previously added.

text.name: Text
text.desc: The message to share. Leave empty to omit.

title.name: Title
title.desc: The title or subject of the share. Leave empty to omit.

url.name: URL
url.desc: A URL to share. Leave empty to omit.

actions.description: Add the contents of a Binary Data object as a file to attach to the next share. Note only works if 'Is sharing files supported' is true.

filename.name: Filename
filename.desc: Name of the file to add.

type.name: Type
type.desc: Content type (also known as MIME type) of the file to add.

data.name: Data
data.desc: A Binary Data object to use as the content of the file.

actions.display-text: Request app rating (body: [i]{0}[/i], confirm: [i]{1}[/i], cancel: [i]{2}[/i], app ID: [i]{3}[/i])
actions.description: Display a dialog requesting the user to rate your application.

dialogText.name: Dialog Text
dialogText.desc: The body text of the request review dialog (Android with no Google Play Store App only).

confirmButtonText.name: Confirm Button Text
confirmButtonText.desc: The text of the "confirm" button on the request review dialog (Android with no Google Play Store App only).

cancelButtonText.name: Cancel Button Text
cancelButtonText.desc: The text of the "cancel" button on the request review dialog (Android with no Google Play Store App only).

appIdentifier.name: App ID
appIdentifier.desc: The app ID to request a rating for (Android with no Google Play Store App only). Leave empty to use the project's app ID.

actions.display-text: Display store page for app ID [i]{0}[/i]
actions.description: Open the 'rate app' store page for an app.

appIdentifier.name: App ID
appIdentifier.desc: The app ID of the store page to open. Leave empty to use the project's app ID.
